in_arabic.name: فخته
in_arabic.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'fakha' which means 'to break' or 'to shatter'. It can be given to a child as a symbol of strength and resilience, as the name implies the ability to overcome obstacles and challenges.

in_urdu.name: فختہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'fakha' which means 'to break' or 'to shatter'. In Urdu, it can be translated to mean 'one who bears hardships' or 'one who endures trials and tribulations'.
